reviews.review: REEEEEEEEEE! PRESS X ON CONTROLLER TO SKIP B.S.!!!
Chaos tends to get a bit quirky.

Despite it being what is now considered an "older" game.. it has even for modern games a solid foundation of gameplay that's highly replayable and enjoyable each time for its sheer and simple carnage, you can be in most cases as brutal or efficient as you want to be but you will have to balance melee and ranged which speaks to its versatility.. im being too clinical here... its a fun ass game if you want to scratch that 40k carnage itch and just rip and tear some orks, Daemons and filthy traitors alike

[b] *Steam deck moment* [/b]
The game played perfectly on Deck, with high settings and whatever the default 16:9 aspect ratio was. I played all the way through the campaign mode and a few hours of multiplayer (so mfing fun) and had a GREAT experience!

[h1] Top 10 shootman game? I think uhhhhhhm..... YES. [/h1]
Seriously, space marine is such a gem of a shooter. Such fun and satisfying third-person gameplay, with a mix of satisfying and viable melee combat and super-satisfying gunplay. The bolter, for example, feels very good, with nice shooting sounds to fit the rocket-propelled .75 caliber rounds the gun uses.
The [b] story [/b] of Space Marines is good, moderate in length for a shooter (around 7-8 hours to complete). IMO it's right around the perfect length. The meat of the story is good, with a nice, albeit expected, twist. It kept me engaged all the way through and was a blast to play through.
Space Marine's [b] MULTIPLAYER [/b] is, IMO, the best part about this game. The few hours I got to play and be in a nearly full lobby were as fun as playing BO2 in high school. HOWEVER, it is tough to find lobbies to get into. I had the most success in the very early hours of the weekend. I am also convinced that the lobby I was in was the only one going. So while it is such a fun mfing, unfortunately, I'd probably recommend against buying the game with multiplayer in mind. Maybe there are discords for it, but it's hard to find public games.

OVERALL, Space Marine is a sick game. The campaign is outstanding; the multiplayer is SUPER fun. However, Sega jacking the price back up to $59.99 for an 11-year-old game is beyond ridiculous. I got this game out of the Warhammer complete bundle on steam in ?2017? for like $80, including both dawn of war 1 and 2 (with all DLC) and company of heroes 1 and 2 (with all DLC). So it is absolutely not worth $59.99 on its own. Pick it up from a CD shop (check allcdkeys for the lowest price). 
Very, VERY good game; Very, VERY bad price.
